title: A sound of the course (assets/sounds/<id>.json)
description: Where a sound of the course comes from and under what licence (docs/decisions.md D67), next to its file assets/sounds/<id>.<ext> (FLAC for what was lossless, the original's own bytes for what came lossy). Written by elabora sound add and sound generate, read by the validator (licences), « IA et crédits » and the package's CREDITS.txt. Never shipped in packages.

title.description: The sound's title, as its source names it (« Old phone ringing »): credits name it.

source.description: Where it was taken: library (Elabora's « Sons courants », CC0), a site (kenney, opengameart, wikimedia, freesound), openverse (found through Openverse: url is the page of its own source), elevenlabs (generated), recording (made by the author), file (a file the author gave).

url.description: The page of the sound at its source.

sourceId.description: Its id there (a Freesound number, a Commons file name, an Elabora library id).

author.description: Who made it, as the licence asks to name them.

license.description: Its licence, as an SPDX-like id: CC0-1.0, PDM-1.0 (public domain mark), CC-BY-4.0, CC-BY-3.0, CC-BY-SA-4.0…, own (made or bought by the author with every right to ship it), generated (made by an AI service under a plan that gives commercial rights). Unknown, non-commercial (NC) or no-derivatives (ND) licences are E_SOUND_LICENSE: a course is sold and a sound is cut.

credit.description: The credit line the licence asks for, as it should read (« “Old phone” by Jane Doe, CC BY 4.0, shortened »); without it, one is made from the title, the author, the licence and what was changed.

modified.description: What was done to the original (CC BY asks to say it).

trim.description: The part of the original kept, in seconds (already applied to the file).

duration.description: Seconds of audio in the file.

loop.description: Made to loop (an ambience, a music bed): the player crossfades its end into its start.

caption.description: A caption it suggests, by language (« Le téléphone sonne. »): written where the sound is used, never imposed.

generated.description: Made by an AI service: « IA et crédits » says the course has generated sounds.

checked.description: When the licence was read on the source's page.
